title: VUA BDL warehouse command result v0.1
description: Acceptance payloads for the B4 warehouse commands (docs/protocols/bdl-commands-v0.1), discriminated by operation. setArtifactMode applies synchronously and reports the entry's resulting effective mode. generateVpm and deleteOriginals are audited maintenance tasks: the result is a task acceptance (taskId + correlationId); their Done payloads (generation receipt with the package id and archive identity; deletion audit with the deleted paths and the kept generated artifact identity) travel the application-contract task surface. Failures are application errors with stable vua.warehouse.* codes and never appear in this schema.
